shortDescription: Simple messaging for people and small groups.
fullDescription:
PulseChat is a focused messaging app for direct conversations and small groups.

Message with confidence
• Send realtime text messages and photos
• Reply, edit, delete and react to messages
• See unread, delivered and read states
• Find people, conversations and messages

Stay in control
• Create and manage small group chats
• Mute conversations and choose notification preferences
• Control people-search and activity visibility
• Block or report unwanted interactions
• Choose light, dark or system appearance

Built for everyday reliability
• Read recent conversations during a connection problem
• Queue text messages and retry them after reconnecting
• Open the exact conversation from a notification
• Delete your account from inside the app

PulseChat requires an account. Message content is protected by authenticated access and server-enforced conversation membership. PulseChat does not claim end-to-end encryption.
releaseNotes: Initial PulseChat internal beta: direct and group messaging, photos, message actions, search, notifications, privacy controls and offline text recovery.
